title: Dual expert (PubMed + Web Search)
input_summary: Use both pubmed-expert AND web-search-expert on CHADS-VASc anticoagulation in elderly AF.
key_finding: When user requests multiple experts, LLM autonomously dispatches BOTH in sequence within a single SSE stream. No parallel execution observed (sequential `Calling expert:` events). iCoDer Orchestrator Gate 3 must support this sequential multi-expert dispatch pattern.
cross_expert_evidence: Both pubmed-expert AND web-search-expert events fire before final text-delta synthesis. Confirms LLM-driven conditional multi-tool dispatch (not a static DAG).
